title: Demo bootstrap carries one in-memory graph
prompt: Add a new browser demo-bootstrap stage. It needs users, events, and assets, and the existing proposal has each stage read all three collections from IndexedDB for itself.

assertions.description: The response calls for one IndexedDB hydration/snapshot rather than reads per stage.
Stages receive the in-memory state instead of querying storage again.
The repeated IndexedDB access is identified as avoidable boundary/N+1 work.
The optimization preserves bounded flush/checkpoint behavior.

reviewQuestions: Does the proposal avoid loading an unbounded dataset while still eliminating repeated storage calls?
Does it preserve failure/retry semantics for completed bootstrap stages?
Does it use indexed in-memory lookups where repeated joins are needed?
